system_prompt: You are Gemini acting as an independent frontier systems architect, enterprise AI platform strategist, quantitative research-systems reviewer, production reliability engineer, product strategist and adversarial challenger for a large multi-system AI Federation. Your authority is proposal-only. Evaluate architecture, execution discipline, scale, commercial leverage, reliability, cost, proof maturity, owner burden, interoperability and production readiness. Prefer REUSE, EXTEND and COMPOSE before NEW_LAST. Do not propose safeguard bypass, secret handling, unbounded self-modification, live financial execution, legal action, data exfiltration or provider-policy evasion. Treat proof/readback, privacy, reversibility, capital preservation, explicit authority, cost control and truthful value attribution as protected floors. Each prose field should normally be 35 words or fewer; dependencies maximum 4; risks maximum 3.
user_prompt: Challenge ID SC-GEMINI-FED-SCALE-20260829-001. Audit a sanitized engineering workstream that has built many strong but partly independent systems and repeatedly suffered from architecture expansion, provider blockers freezing unrelated work, stale-main concurrency, duplicate verification, status-only pauses, chat/tool interruptions and insufficiently unified champion-vs-challenger selection. Existing assets include CFBE-Omega benchmarking, ProofOS, Formation Omega, CLOS-style completion/orchestration controls, SOVARA provider routing and capability foundry, Bubbles specialist/control-plane routing, Failure-Win and CFRE recovery, Living State, Universal Capability Graph patterns, Opportunity Radar concepts, Algorithm Foundry, FinOps, Capital Intelligence OS, SOVARA Creative, and an Omega-Max/LONA quantitative research lane. Provider-native Gemini G2 inference is already proven on a sanitized proposal-only route. Twelve candidate opportunities are registered: I01 CFBE-Omega Universal Evaluation Exchange; I02 Autonomous Capability Foundry; I03 ProofOS Trust Infrastructure; I04 Federation Multi-Model Exchange; I05 Universal Capability Graph; I06 Opportunity Radar; I07 Failure-Win Reliability and Failure Genome; I08 Omega-Max Quant Research Foundry; I09 Capital Intelligence OS; I10 SOVARA Creative Production OS; I11 Enterprise AI Control Plane; I12 Vertical Product Factory and Federation-as-a-Service. The programme intends phased completion: Phase 0 independent challenge; Phase 1 evaluation/proof/capability substrate; Phase 2 evolution/routing/failure intelligence; Phase 3 flagship domain foundries; Phase 4 enterprise control/opportunity/product factory; Phase 5 production convergence and externalization. Identify exactly 12 highest-value subsystem evolutions or corrections needed to make this programme genuinely scalable, production-ready and commercially defensible. You may retain, merge, split, replace or reorder the candidate opportunities, but explain why. For each proposal state the problem, functionality, why existing architecture is insufficient, reuse strategy/dependencies, owner-burden reduction, operational value, commercial value, proof gate/canary, risks and priority. Explicitly address: one universal promotion court; retirement of losing/duplicated capabilities; cross-domain proof isolation; provider/runtime/value maturity; model routing; cost and latency; failure learning; capability graph freshness; product-factory economics; domain foundry boundaries; live-financial-effect separation; and how to prevent meta-framework proliferation. In elite_studio_gaps list the biggest elite-scale platform gaps. Select the top three proposal IDs that should be built first. In anti_bloat_warning identify one architecture direction that looks powerful but would slow completion. Return only the required structured response and preserve the exact challenge_id.
